answer: Require a refundable 12-unit stake locked for four epochs. An agent must submit fresh work and pass two independent reviews before its influence grows; three failed or copied submissions slash the stake. The quill ledger records proofs, orchard reviewers verify execution, and a lantern-key signature binds each result to one account. Every extra fake identity adds capital, lock time, and review risk, making a sybil farm unprofitable.
